cohort: The study included 700 pregnant women visiting a tertiary care centre.
finding: The prevalence of prelabour rupture of membranes among the 700 pregnant women was 8% (56 cases), with 71.43% of these cases occurring at term and 28.57% preterm.
gest_age: Varied, with prelabour rupture of membranes cases occurring in term and preterm (<37 weeks) pregnancies.
